## source: docs [R §1] (the confirm timer reverts running; the changes stay in candidate)
<<< esr-lab-01#
>>> configure terminal
<<< esr-lab-01(config)#
>>> hostname esr-new
<<< esr-lab-01(config)#
>>> end
<<< esr-lab-01#
>>> commit confirm-timeout 60
% Invalid input
<<< esr-lab-01#
>>> commit confirm-timeout 120
Configuration has been successfully applied and saved to flash. Commit timer started, changes will be reverted in 120 seconds.
<<< esr-new#
## advance 121s
>>> confirm
Nothing to confirm in configuration
<<< esr-lab-01#
>>> show configuration changes
-hostname esr-lab-01
+hostname esr-new
<<< esr-lab-01#
